# Walker Intelligence Group

> Walker Intelligence Group is an AI consulting and implementation firm based in Indianapolis, Indiana, founded in 2026 by Dustin Walker. It helps small and mid-sized organizations adopt AI and modern technology practically: assessing where they stand, building a clear plan, and then building, deploying, and hosting the solution.

## Services

- Workflow Automation: automate repetitive data entry, reporting, routing, and follow-ups; connect tools that don't talk to each other.
- Websites & Custom Apps: lead-generating websites, online forms, client portals, dashboards, and custom tools, with ongoing hosting and support.
- AI Integration: document review, summarization, and extraction; AI-powered internal tools; safe implementation where client data stays private.
- Technology Infrastructure: cloud setup, backups, storage, security assessment, and technology audits.
- AI Advisory: plain-English technology assessments, highest-ROI AI opportunities, and tool recommendations based on data sensitivity.
- Cost Optimization: audit software subscriptions, remove redundant tools, right-size cloud spend.

## How engagements work

1. Discovery & Strategy: stakeholder interviews, audit of tools and workflows, prioritized roadmap.
2. Technology Assessment: review of the current stack, security posture, and integration gaps.
3. Implementation & Delivery: full build, deployment, hosting, and ongoing maintenance.
